newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close flat, debate outcome awaited.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close flat, debate outcome awaited.

text.p: Thai stocks closed flat on Friday as market activity thinned and investors were sidelined awaiting an outcome from an ongoing censure debate against premier Banharn Silpa-archa, brokers said.
The index ended 2.48 points lower at 1,045.38 after moving in a tight 1,036.84-1,050.92 range on thin 3.47 billion baht.
SET-50 index inched down 0.17 points to 80.18.

"The index moved according to tone of the debate between the government and opposition," said an International Trust and Finance broker. Poeple were undecided on what to do as the debate had not produced a result yet, other brokers added.
Prime minister Banharn Silpa-archa faces a no-confidence motion accusing him of economic mismanagement and a host of other things. The censure vote takes place on Saturday.
Brokers said there was light buying interest before the market closed from investors who believed there would be changes to the government after the vote.

The finance sector was the most active on 1.06 billion baht turnover. Finance One lost 1.50 baht to 99.50. Nava Finance shed 0.50 to 55. The banking sector slipped marginally. Thai Military Bank was off 0.50 baht to 77.50 and Bangkok Bank lost two to 218.
